title: Rule Reshaping
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji thought the chess game was set, a诡异的波动 came from the depths of the Xuanwu Sect—there lurked the shadow of eyes beyond Heavenly Dao, watching all of this.

text.content:
Night wind howling, moonlight如霜。

Chen Ji stood atop the ruins, gazing at those black scales glittering under the moonlight, a meaningful smile curling his lips. The Holy Maiden's Order—that was proof Ye Qing had never betrayed. He had waited for this moment for three full years.

Three years ago, he had seen that scene in the Tianji Record: the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path turning under the moonlight, scales slipping from her sleeve. At that time, he still didn't know what it meant, now he understood—that was a transaction, a transaction sufficient to leverage the entire chess game.

dialogue.content:
Holy Maiden's Order appears, shackles loosen.

Ye Qing, your choice was not wrong.

text.content:
He bent down to pick up that scale, cold as snow in his hand, yet carrying a bizarre heat—that was the气息 of demonic path cultivation techniques. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve faintly burned hot, as if sensing something.

Chen Ji knew, the real test had just begun. The appearance of the Holy Maiden's Order meant the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path was about to察觉到 Ye Qing's betrayal. And he must, before that, complete the rewriting of the rules.

dialogue.content:
Tianji Record, since I have chosen it, don't blame me for being crazy.

He suddenly activated the spiritual energy in his body, pouring the Heavenly Fate Value into the Tianji Record Fragment. In that instant,风云变色, as if something in heaven and earth was being awakened.

text.content:
Above the firmament, a pair of invisible eyes suddenly opened.

That was the Heavenly Dao's Eye—凌驾于众生之上, overlooking the entire chessboard. It亘古不变地注视 human realm, weaving all fates into a net, treating all living beings as chess pieces.

And now, it noticed Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
"A mere ant dares to窥视 Heavenly Secrets?"

That voice exploded directly in Chen Ji's mind,恢弘而冷漠, as if the Great Dao itself was震怒. The terrifying威压如山岳倾覆, madly crushing Chen Ji's divine soul.

text.content:
Blood seeped from Chen Ji's seven apertures, his divine soul seemed torn apart. But he laughed, laughed madly and joyfully.

He had waited for this day, waited too long.

Since obtaining the Tianji Record Fragment, he had been waiting for this opportunity to directly confront the Heavenly Dao's Eye. He knew this day would come eventually—because every move of his was advancing toward this ending.

dialogue.content:
(The Heavenly Dao's Eye, is it? You have玩弄众生 for so many years, today let me see just how many pounds you weigh, this so-called Heavenly Dao!)

He roared to the sky, pouring all thirty points of Heavenly Fate Value into the Tianji Record without reservation!

text.content:
In that instant, the Tianji Record Fragment erupted with dazzling golden light, countless ancient runes pouring out like a flood, weaving into an enormous net in the Void.

Every node of that net connected to a strand of fate—that was evidence of countless living beings manipulated by Heavenly Dao.

And now, Chen Ji was about to completely tear apart this net!

In the distance, Ling Yuan's figure appeared above the clouds.

This old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect had a face gloomy as water, eyes flickering with难以置信的光芒. The chess game he had operated for hundreds of years, the shackles he had carefully arranged, were being瓦解一点一点 by a废物 disciple he had never cared about.

dialogue.content:
"Impossible! This is absolutely impossible!"

Ling Yuan's voice trembled, "The Tianji Record is merely a fragment, how could he rewrite the rules?! Unless..."

His pupils suddenly contracted, as if thinking of some terrible possibility.

text.content:
Unless from the beginning, Chen Ji was not using the Tianji Record—the Tianji Record itself was guiding him toward this ending.

What did that mean? It meant even the Heavenly Dao's Eye was merely a chess piece in an even larger game?

Ling Yuan's forehead oozed cold sweat, feeling true fear for the first time.

Above the firmament, golden light flourished greatly.

The runes of the Tianji Record were like countless sharp blades, madly cutting the net of fate that shrouded all beings' lives. Each strand of fate cut, one living being broke free from shackles—though they themselves were oblivious.

The Demonic Path army began to骚动.

The commander raised his head,震惊地望着天空, he felt the invisible束缚 in his body loosening—the restriction imposed by the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, unshakable for thousands of years, was now dissolving little by little.

choice.prompt: The power of the Tianji Record is tearing the net of fate, but the Heavenly Dao's Eye's backlash is also coming. Chen Ji feels his Heavenly Fate Value draining madly, his divine soul剧烈震颤—continue full output, or preserve strength for the next variables?

choices.description: Pour all power into this strike, completely tear apart the fated shackles. The cost is Chen Ji will fall into extreme weakness.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero, falling into weakness
choices.visible_reward: Fated shackles completely collapse, Chen Ji's influence reaches its peak
choices.risk_hint: If enemies take advantage of the weakness, there will be no counterattack

text.content:
Chen Ji clenched his teeth tightly, pouring the last thread of spiritual energy into the Tianji Record.

Golden light surged暴涨, transforming into a pillar reaching the heavens,冲向九霄!

dialogue.content:
(Thirty years fortune, thirty years misfortune! After today, I Chen Ji am the Chess Player of this game!)

The Heavenly Dao's Eye let out an angry roar, terrifying thunder slashed from the Void—but was completely blocked by that golden net!

choices.description: Only output seventy percent power to tear open the shackles, while preserving room to deal with Ling Yuan's counterattack.
choices.visible_cost: Shackles not completely broken, may leave hidden troubles
choices.visible_reward: Maintain combat strength, can seize initiative in subsequent confrontation
choices.risk_hint: Rule reshaping not thorough enough, Heavenly Dao's Eye still has room to maneuver

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes flashed, choosing a more prudent strategy.

Golden light transformed into countless blades,methodically cutting the net of fate—though slower, each step was steady, giving enemies no opportunity to exploit.

dialogue.content:
(Old fox, what are you waiting for? Your hidden card, it's time to reveal it, isn't it?)

His神识 secretly scanned toward Ling Yuan's direction, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips.

choices.text: Borrow force to strike, divert the flood
choices.description: Deliberately expose a flaw, lure Ling Yuan to strike, catch him off guard and transfer Heavenly Dao's backlash onto him.
choices.visible_cost: Need to withstand Ling Yuan's full-power strike
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone, weaken both major enemies simultaneously
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan sees through the scheme, will fall into desperate situation

text.content:
Chen Ji deliberately revealed a flaw, his divine soul power fluctuating slightly.

As expected, Ling Yuan's eyes lit up—he saw his chance! The old Sect Master's figure ghostly rushed over, a palm striking toward Chen Ji's back!

dialogue.content:
(Caught in the trap!)

Chen Ji suddenly turned around, the Tianji Record's golden light flourishing brilliantly, absorbing all of Ling Yuan's attack—then反弹 it back to the Heavenly Dao's Eye completely intact!

text.content:
The Heavenly Dao's Eye issued a thunderous怒吼.

It never expected its arranged chess piece would turn against itself. Ling Yuan's attack carrying thousands of years of cultivation, after being amplified by the Tianji Record, transformed into a world-destroying torrent,冲向那双亘古无波的眼睛!

Golden net collapsed, the firmament cracked open a huge缝隙.

Countless shackles dissolved from all beings—someone suddenly enlightened, breaking through a long-standing bottleneck; someone's years of暗疾 healed without medicine; someone saw scenery they had never seen in a dream...

And Chen Ji, the initiator of all this,悬浮在虚空之中,浑身浴血, yet laughing wildly.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji... you did well!"

The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice carried emotion for the first time—that was anger, was wariness,更是 一种从未有过的危机感。

"This one remembers you. This round, you win. But the game is far from over—"

Before the words finished, those eyes dissipated into the Void, as if never existing.

Ling Yuan stumbled backward, his gaze at Chen Ji like seeing a ghost.

"How is this possible... you, a mere废物, how could you injure the Heavenly Dao's Eye!"

His voice嘶哑, "I plotted for hundreds of years, sacrificed countless people, just to gain the Tianji Record's recognition—why you! Why!"

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly landed, each step extremely steady.

His face pale as paper,气息虚弱到了极点, but his eyes blazingly bright. He walked step by step toward Ling Yuan, toward this existence he once looked up to.

Ling Yuan下意识后退一步.

The堂堂 Tianqing Sect old Sect Master,此刻竟被 a servant disciple逼得后退—this scene if spread,足以让整个修真界地震.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji stood still, tilting his head to打量 Ling Yuan, the smile at his lips growing more teasing.

"Old Sect Master, what did you just say?废物?"

He lightly brushed the dust off his clothes, "I remember three years ago, you personally told this disciple—'if you can break through to the third stage of Qi Refining in this life, it's because your ancestors' graves were blessed.' Today this disciple specially came to repay these words to you—

If you can die at the hands of废物 in this life, your ancestors' graves are truly blessed."

text.content:
Ling Yuan气得浑身发抖, yet dared not act rashly.

That scene just now was too shocking, even the Heavenly Dao's Eye retreated, his区区一个 old Sect Master又怎么敢上前? Moreover, his hidden cards had been消耗了大半 by Chen Ji's借力打力,此刻完全是色厉内荏.

In the distance, the Demonic Path army had begun to retreat.

The commander fled仓皇 under the护送 of personal guards,临走前回头看了一眼 Chen Ji, eyes full of wariness. He didn't know what this young man had done, but he knew—this person's terribleness had exceeded his cognition.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan已是强弩之末, but Chen Ji同样虚弱至此. Seize this opportunity to permanently eliminate future troubles, or let the long line extend for bigger fish?

choices.text: Root out the weeds, eliminate future troubles
choices.description: Send Ling Yuan on his way today, completely end this grudge spanning hundreds of years.
choices.visible_cost: Consume the last of one's strength, may leave暗伤
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan falls, Tianqing Sect power entirely under control
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan has hidden means, may result in两败俱伤

text.content:
Chen Ji no longer wasted words, fingers lightly flicked.

A golden light broke through the air,直奔 Ling Yuan's眉心!

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji! You dare!"

Ling Yuan madly activated护体灵气, yet was惊觉 to find his body's spiritual energy运转滞涩—that was the trace left by being侵染 by the Tianji Record's golden light earlier!

Golden light entered his body, Ling Yuan's瞳孔骤然放大, body slowly fell.

choices.text: Spare his life, extend the line
choices.description: Let Ling Yuan become a visible chess piece, attracting the Heavenly Dao's Eye's attention.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan may recover and counterattack
choices.visible_reward: Hidden layout, can advance or retreat
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan joins forces with the Heavenly Dao's Eye, threat doubles

text.content:
Chen Ji retracted his fingers,淡淡一笑.

"Old Sect Master, you being alive is more useful than being dead."

dialogue.content:
"The Heavenly Dao's Eye has already noticed me, if I kill you too, wouldn't that rob it of a出气筒?"

He turned around,背对 Ling Yuan, "You just live well, be my shield."

Ling Yuan气得七窍生烟, yet一句 也说不出来.

text.content:
Night wind brushed across the battlefield,带走 the血腥气 filling the sky.

Chen Ji静静地站在废墟之中,望着天边泛起的鱼肚白. This night will inevitably be recorded in history. The Heavenly Dao's Eye retreated, fated shackles collapsed, the rules of the chess game completely rewritten.

From now on, he is no longer a chess piece.

He is the Chess Player.

The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve微微发热, as if celebrating his victory. But Chen Ji knew, this is just the beginning. Mo Xiansheng said, the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fated death backlash—yet he now has only触及了冰山一角.

dialogue.content:
(Heavenly Dao's Eye... you wait and see.)

Chen Ji raised his head,望着那已经恢复平静的天穹,嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的笑.

(This chess game has just begun.)

text.content:
Just then, a苍老的声音 suddenly rang in his mind—that was Mo Xiansheng, the mysterious existence existing as a残魂 on the first page of the Tianji Record.

"Well done, first volume objective achieved."

Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a trace of赞许, "The knowledge of the second page of the Tianji Record has been unlocked. Now, let me tell you something you must know—about your sister, Chen Nian."

Chen Ji's瞳孔骤然收缩.

Three years, he finally heard this name again.

"Chen Nian is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight."

Mo Xiansheng's voice悠悠响起, "This is why, every time you foresee her future, the image is blurred. But now, the rules have been rewritten—you have the chance to see the true answer."

Chen Ji's heartbeat骤然加速.

Three years, he had planned for the world, calculated without missing anything,唯独对妹妹的事一筹莫展. And now, the fated shackles have collapsed, he can finally find that missing girl.

"Where is she?"

Chen Ji's voice微微颤抖, this was the first time he失态 before Mo Xiansheng.

"The Xuanwu Sect."

Mo Xiansheng吐出 three characters, "The core of Volume Five is at the Xuanwu Sect. And your predestined feud with the Xuanwu genius Han Lie will also迎来 its final confrontation there."

Chen Ji closed his eyes,深吸一口气.

Han Lie, that家伙 with a simple mind but reverse combat power. Their grudge dates back ten years to a conflict. Back then Chen Ji was still a废物 at the first stage of Qi Refining, while Han Lie was already the天之骄子 of Xuanwu Sect.

Ten years later today, the废物 has rewritten fate, while the genius remains in place.

But Mo Xiansheng's words made him realize, Han Lie's existence is恐怕没那么简单.

"Behind Han Lie, there is the shadow of eyes beyond the Heavenly Dao."

Mo Xiansheng's voice突然变得严肃, "You think the Heavenly Dao's Eye is the final enemy? Wrong. It is merely a chess piece of a higher existence. And that existence is hidden in the depths of the Xuanwu Sect."

Chen Ji's eyes猛然睁开.

An existence beyond the Heavenly Dao's Eye? That would mean...

"Correct." Mo Xiansheng seemed to看穿 his thoughts, "The Heavenly Dao's Eye is merely Heavenly Dao's eye. What is truly terrifying is—Heavenly Dao itself."

The words fell, the Tianji Record Fragment剧烈震颤起来.

Chen Ji felt an unprecedented pressure涌来 from all directions.

That was power beyond his cognition, an existence even the Heavenly Dao's Eye must bow to. It hid in the depths of the Void,正注视着今夜发生的一切.

Perhaps, from the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, these eyes had been watching him.

Chen Ji suddenly laughed.

"Coward hiding in shadows."

He低声呢喃, voice虽然虚弱,语气却充满了不屑, "You think you're on the seventh level, but I'm actually on the eighth.玩弄命运? Who's afraid of whom."

At the horizon, the first rays of sunlight pierced the clouds,照在 Chen Ji's苍白的脸上.

A new round, begins.
